# Mohammad Ali Kohandezh

> Mohammad Ali Kohandezh is an AI and quantum-readiness advisor and CEO of Kohan System Farda (KSF), an enterprise IT and AI company based in Tehran, Iran. He advises organisations on applied AI, post-quantum readiness and cybersecurity, drawing on enterprise IT infrastructure, virtualization and disaster-recovery work carried out since 2007.

He holds 43 professional certifications (including VMware VCP-DCV, EC-Council CEH/CHFI, HPE ATP, GIAC/SANS SEC504/SEC542) and works out of TechElite, the Nokhbegan Technology Growth Center (Masir 21), Pardis Technology Park, Tehran, Iran.

## Advisory

- [AI readiness assessment](https://kohandezh.com/#service): evidence-based review of where AI is already in use, what it is permitted to touch, where its answers come from and who is accountable when it errs
- [Post-quantum readiness assessment](https://kohandezh.com/#service): cryptographic inventory, data-lifetime analysis and a dated migration roadmap to the NIST post-quantum standards (ML-KEM, ML-DSA)
- [Secure AI architecture design](https://kohandezh.com/#service): retrieval, identity and least-privilege design for enterprise AI agents, sized so the client's own team can build and defend it
